summary: We've been made aware of an outage affecting customers on Redtrain services in Fraser Rise; we're raising a ticket with Redtrain and awaiting further details. We'll provide updates as soon as we can.

updates.note: Redtrain are advising that the outage has now ben resolved. They are currently awaiting for a formal update from the backhaul provider and continuing to monitor the link to ensure stability. If you still have no service, please reboot your router and Redtrain equipment, and call through to our support line.

Redtrain advises that Telstra has engaged their field/fibre specialists to attend the impacted site and conduct further investigation. At this time, Telstra is currently awaiting confirmation of technician dispatch and attendance ETA. Redtrain has promised to provide a further update as soon as these details become available.

Redtrain is advising that the backhaul provider closed the fault ticket, but the link is still down. Redtrain have run another OTDR test from Fraser Rise toward 530 Collins Street and confirmed the signal drop is still occurring. A new ticket has been lodged and pushed for urgent resolution.

Please be advised that Telstra civil contractors had to excavate on-site to clear an underground conduit blockage and are now nearly finished hauling the new fibre cable. They are currently coordinating cable technicians / fibre splicers to attend and splice the new cable once the haul is completed.

The backhaul provider has engaged a civil contractor to clear a duct blockage and re-haul new fibre. Following this, the backhaul provider's team will attend the site in the afternoon and begin to restore services.
The backhaul provider has localised the fault, and the issue has been escalated for urgent remediation.

Technicians from the backhaul provider have been on site, and their fibre team is now organising repair works. The backhaul provider hasn't given an estimated time for restoration yet, but we'll share updates as soon as they're available

Technician has attended and advised there's a break in the fibre, they're lodging a fault with their backhaul provider to get this break fixed as soon as possible. There is currently no ETR, but we expect an update once the backhaul provider accepts the ticket.
Redtrain have acknowledged the outage and advised they'll be sending a technician to investigate. There is no current ETR.

summary: An upstream provider is performing maintenance on backhaul links that it provides to Launtel. They have advised there will be up to 90 minutes of downtime during the maintenance window.

updates.note: This planned maintenance is being performed by one of our backhaul providers, which will impact Launtel customers. They have advised there will be up to 90 minutes of service interruption during their maintenance works.
